hypotheses.title: Worn punch P3 in MT-07 due to exceeded sharpening interval
hypotheses.rationale: The lot L26245-AR1007-01 was produced on 2026-09-02 with 3,000 strokes on PR-250. The sharpening interval per PROC-L1-AFILADO-01 v3 is 60,000 strokes, but the counter at the time of production was at 58,000 strokes. Previous 8D analyses confirm that punch wear causes undersized holes and burrs. The defect pattern (highest burr at 3 o'clock) matches punch wear progression.
hypotheses.verification: Measure the cutting edge radius of punch P3 removed from MT-07 and compare with PROC-L1-AFILADO-01 v3 limits.

recurrence.summary: El defecto de porosidad en el e-coat del soporte AR-1009 ocurrió previamente en el lote L24151-AR1009-01 (2024-07-09) con la misma causa raíz y acciones correctivas. La reclamación actual (2026-09-23) sugiere una recurrencia en el lote L26250-AR1009-01.

hypotheses.title: Contamination of e-coat bath by phosphate carry-over from previous process
hypotheses.rationale: The craters are localized along the MIG seam and within ±5 mm, where phosphate residues from welding can accumulate. EDX detected Si, Mn and O (glassy residue) in craters, consistent with phosphate contamination. The 8D from 2024 (C-OEMN-2024-0163) confirmed this mechanism with contaminated bath samples (11 craters/dm²) and resolution after fresh bath + DI rinse <10 µS/cm.

hypotheses.title: Insufficient DI rinse conductivity control leading to phosphate carry-over
hypotheses.rationale: High DI rinse conductivity (>30 µS/cm) was a confirmed contributing cause in 2024 (38 µS/cm recorded). AMFE row specifies an alarm at 20 µS/cm with stop, but the 8D report indicates no alarm limit was active during the incident. This allowed phosphate carry-over to the e-coat bath.

hypotheses.title: Non-detection due to lack of porosity inspection in final control plan
hypotheses.rationale: The control plan for AR-1009 (PC-AR1003-01) specifies thickness measurement (19–23 µm) but no porosity or crater check. The 8D from 2024 explicitly states that thickness measurement alone does not detect pinholes. The defect was only detected at OEM Norte's incoming audit.
hypotheses.verification: Update control plan to include porosity/crater inspection (100% or sampling) and verify implementation in production.

hypotheses.title: Zn-Ni coating thickness of nut lot S-BIDA-260136 at the upper limit (11.5–12.0 µm)
hypotheses.rationale: The coating thickness of the nut lot S-BIDA-260136 is at the upper limit of the specification (8–12 µm), which increases contact resistance and zinc vapour during welding, reducing energy at the interface. This matches the failure mode described in of AMFE-AR1006-01 and aligns with the root cause identified in 8D-ARGA-2025-008 for a similar defect.
hypotheses.verification: Verify the actual coating thickness of nut lot S-BIDA-260136 using XRF at reception and confirm if it exceeds the agreed window of 8–11 µm.

hypotheses.title: Insufficient torque-out test frequency (3 pieces every 2 hours)
hypotheses.rationale: The torque-out test frequency (3 pieces every 2 hours) was insufficient to detect the defect in real time, as evidenced by the fact that 12 defective parts were produced before detection. This aligns with the non-detection root cause identified in 8D-ARGA-2025-008 and the AMFE row , which highlights the risk of small sample sizes in detection controls.
hypotheses.verification: Review the torque-out test records for lot L26252-AR1010-01 and confirm if the test frequency was adhered to and if any deviations occurred during the tarde shift on 2026-09-09.

hypotheses.title: Weld schedule not validated for Zn-Ni coating at the upper limit
hypotheses.rationale: The weld schedule (T06) was validated only with mid-range coating (9–10 µm), but the nut lot S-BIDA-260136 has a coating thickness at the upper limit (11.5–12.0 µm). This could explain the insufficient energy at the interface, but the validation status of the schedule for this coating condition needs confirmation.
hypotheses.verification: Verify if the weld schedule T06 was validated for Zn-Ni coating thicknesses at the upper limit (11.5–12.0 µm) and if adjustments were made for lot S-BIDA-260136.

query.sql: SELECT code, name, customer_type, report_template, report_language, containment_hours, report_days FROM erp.customers WHERE code = %(code)s

SELECT l.lot_code, l.part_ref, l.order_id, l.production_date, l.shift, l.press, l.weld_cell, l.qty_produced, l.qty_scrap, l.status, l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code, p.description AS part_description, p.customer_code, p.routing, p.material AS part_material, p.thickness_mm, p.special_char, p.char_class, p.die, p.uses_weld_nut FROM erp.lots l JOIN erp.parts p ON p.ref = l.part_ref WHERE l.lot_code = %(lot_code)s

SELECT m.lot_code, m.supplier_code, m.material, m.received_date, m.qty, m.unit, m.certificate_ok, m.notes FROM erp.lots l JOIN erp.material_lots m ON m.lot_code IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) WHERE l.lot_code = %(lot_code)s

SELECT c.complaint_id, c.customer_code, c.part_ref, c.lot_code, c.received_date, c.defect, c.qty_affected, c.status, c.report_8d_id FROM erp.complaints c WHERE (%(part_ref)s::text IS NULL OR c.part_ref = %(part_ref)s) AND (%(customer_code)s::text IS NULL OR c.customer_code = %(customer_code)s) AND (%(from_date)s::date IS NULL OR c.received_date >= %(from_date)s) AND (%(status)s::text IS NULL OR c.status = %(status)s) ORDER BY c.received_date, c.complaint_id LIMIT 200

SELECT c.complaint_id, c.customer_code, c.part_ref, c.lot_code, c.received_date, c.defect, c.qty_affected, c.status, c.report_8d_id FROM erp.complaints c WHERE (%(part_ref)s::text IS NULL OR c.part_ref = %(part_ref)s) AND (%(customer_code)s::text IS NULL OR c.customer_code = %(customer_code)s) AND (%(from_date)s::date IS NULL OR c.received_date >= %(from_date)s) AND (%(status)s::text IS NULL OR c.status = %(status)s) ORDER BY c.received_date, c.complaint_id LIMIT 200

SELECT p.ref AS part_ref, p.customer_code, p.weld_cell, p.uses_weld_nut, p.press, p.die, count(*) AS lots, min(l.production_date) AS first_production_date, max(l.production_date) AS last_production_date FROM erp.lots l JOIN erp.parts p ON p.ref = l.part_ref WHERE %(material_lot_code)s IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) GROUP BY p.ref, p.customer_code, p.weld_cell, p.uses_weld_nut, p.press, p.die ORDER BY p.ref LIMIT 200

SELECT l.lot_code, l.part_ref, l.production_date, l.shift, l.weld_cell, l.qty_produced, l.qty_scrap, l.status FROM erp.lots l WHERE l.part_ref = ANY(%(part_refs)s) AND %(material_lot_code)s IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) ORDER BY l.part_ref, l.production_date, l.lot_code

SELECT s.shipment_id, s.lot_code, l.part_ref, s.customer_code, s.ship_date, s.qty FROM erp.lots l JOIN erp.shipments s ON s.lot_code = l.lot_code WHERE l.part_ref = ANY(%(part_refs)s) AND %(material_lot_code)s IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) ORDER BY l.part_ref, s.ship_date, s.shipment_id

SELECT l.lot_code, l.part_ref, l.order_id, l.production_date, l.shift, l.press, l.weld_cell, l.qty_produced, l.qty_scrap, l.status, l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code FROM erp.lots l WHERE l.part_ref = %(part_ref)s AND l.production_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND (%(wire_lot_code)s::text IS NULL OR l.wire_lot_code = %(wire_lot_code)s) AND (%(steel_lot_code)s::text IS NULL OR l.steel_lot_code = %(steel_lot_code)s) AND (%(weld_cell)s::text IS NULL OR l.weld_cell = %(weld_cell)s) AND (%(shift)s::text IS NULL OR l.shift = %(shift)s) AND (%(status)s::text IS NULL OR l.status = %(status)s) ORDER BY l.production_date, l.lot_code LIMIT 200

SELECT s.shipment_id, s.lot_code, l.part_ref, s.customer_code, s.ship_date, s.qty FROM erp.shipments s JOIN erp.lots l ON l.lot_code = s.lot_code WHERE (%(lot_code)s::text IS NULL OR s.lot_code = %(lot_code)s) AND (%(part_ref)s::text IS NULL OR l.part_ref = %(part_ref)s) AND (%(from_date)s::date IS NULL OR s.ship_date >= %(from_date)s) AND (%(to_date)s::date IS NULL OR s.ship_date <= %(to_date)s) ORDER BY s.ship_date, s.shipment_id LIMIT 200
